name: Jornada da O.S.
description: Rastreamento de uma O.S. pelos três microsserviços (application, payment, services-ms) pelo atributo service_order_id

rawConfiguration.text:
**Jornada da O.S.** — cole o id da O.S. no filtro *Id da O.S.* no topo.

Atributo comum: `service_order_id`.

- **application**: eventos `ServiceOrderCreated`, `ServiceOrderStatusDuration` e logs (`context.service_order_id`)
- **payment**: evento `PaymentSaga`
- **services-ms**: logs `journey.source = 'services-ms'`

Status alterados pelas Lambdas da aplicação (consumer da execução) não aparecem do lado da aplicação: veja os passos do services-ms.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) AS 'Passos' FROM Log, ServiceOrderCreated, ServiceOrderStatusDuration WHERE (service_order_id = {{service_order_id}} OR context.service_order_id = {{service_order_id}}) AND (eventType() != 'Log' OR context.service_order_id IS NOT NULL) SINCE 30 days ago
SELECT count(*) AS 'Passos' FROM PaymentSaga WHERE service_order_id = {{service_order_id}} SINCE 30 days ago
SELECT count(*) AS 'Passos' FROM Log WHERE journey.source = 'services-ms' AND service_order_id = {{service_order_id}} SINCE 30 days ago

SELECT count(*) AS 'Avisos' FROM Log, PaymentSaga WHERE (service_order_id = {{service_order_id}} OR context.service_order_id = {{service_order_id}}) AND (level = 'WARN' OR status IN ('REJECTED', 'EXPIRED', 'LINK_ERROR', 'DUPLICATE')) SINCE 30 days ago

widgets.title: Linha do tempo nos três serviços

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT timestamp, eventType() AS 'Tipo', journey.source AS 'MS', step AS 'Passo (payment)', event AS 'Passo (MS)', context.event AS 'Passo (app)', status, new_status AS 'Novo status (app)', previous_status, event_type, reason, mpStatus, message FROM Log, PaymentSaga, ServiceOrderCreated, ServiceOrderStatusDuration WHERE (service_order_id = {{service_order_id}} OR context.service_order_id = {{service_order_id}}) SINCE 30 days ago LIMIT MAX

SELECT timestamp, eventType() AS 'Tipo', context.event AS 'Passo', status, previous_status, new_status, status_duration_seconds, message FROM Log, ServiceOrderCreated, ServiceOrderStatusDuration WHERE (service_order_id = {{service_order_id}} OR context.service_order_id = {{service_order_id}}) AND (eventType() != 'Log' OR context.service_order_id IS NOT NULL) SINCE 30 days ago LIMIT MAX
SELECT timestamp, step, status, attempt, mpStatus, mpStatusDetail, durationSeconds, orderId FROM PaymentSaga WHERE service_order_id = {{service_order_id}} SINCE 30 days ago LIMIT MAX

SELECT timestamp, event, level, status, event_type, service_order_service_id, duration_seconds, redrive_attempt, reason FROM Log WHERE journey.source = 'services-ms' AND service_order_id = {{service_order_id}} SINCE 30 days ago LIMIT MAX

pages.name: Saga — falhas e recuperação
pages.description: Falhas e compensações de todas as O.S.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) FROM PaymentSaga WHERE status IN ('REJECTED', 'EXPIRED', 'LINK_ERROR') FACET status TIMESERIES SINCE 1 day ago
SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE journey.source = 'services-ms' AND level = 'WARN' FACET event TIMESERIES SINCE 1 day ago
SELECT count(*) FROM ServiceOrderError FACET error_type TIMESERIES SINCE 1 day ago

SELECT latest(timestamp) AS 'Último', latest(status) AS 'Status', count(*) AS 'Eventos' FROM PaymentSaga WHERE status IN ('REJECTED', 'EXPIRED', 'LINK_ERROR') AND service_order_id IS NOT NULL FACET service_order_id SINCE 7 days ago LIMIT 50
SELECT latest(timestamp) AS 'Último', latest(event) AS 'Passo', count(*) AS 'Avisos' FROM Log WHERE journey.source = 'services-ms' AND level = 'WARN' FACET service_order_id SINCE 7 days ago LIMIT 50

widgets.title: O.S. que passaram pelos três serviços

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT filter(count(*), WHERE eventType() = 'PaymentSaga') AS 'payment', filter(count(*), WHERE journey.source = 'services-ms') AS 'services-ms', filter(count(*), WHERE eventType() IN ('ServiceOrderCreated', 'ServiceOrderStatusDuration')) AS 'application' FROM PaymentSaga, Log, ServiceOrderCreated, ServiceOrderStatusDuration WHERE service_order_id IS NOT NULL FACET service_order_id SINCE 7 days ago LIMIT 50
